subject: [PATCH v3 07/11] scsi: mpt3sas: Reset the TUR retry count for each device

2026-11-18.patch_summary: This patch fixes an issue in the MPT3SAS driver where the retry count for TEST UNIT READY (TUR) operations was not being reset correctly for each device, leading to incorrect behavior when the retry budget is exhausted. The problem occurs because the retry counter is set to 0 once per call, rather than once per device, causing retries on one device to consume the retry budget of all later devices. This patch resets the count to 0 for each sdev, ensuring that each device has its own retry budget. The fix addresses an issue introduced by a previous patch that added a configurable command retry limit for slow-to-respond devices.
